final_message:
Configured the requested host names and MX records, with all 20 PCs using the resolver on pc18. Existing connections, addresses and routes were left unchanged.

The DNS hierarchy uses pc1 for the root, pc2–pc3 for `com` and `net`, and pc10 and pc14–pc17 for the requested domains. This assumes the existing `kathara/base` images provide BIND; no images were changed.

Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. BIND validation tools were unavailable, and live DNS queries were not run, so the configuration still needs runtime verification. MX records identify the mail hosts; they do not configure mail server software.
